title: Parcel from Taiwan (CBI digital arrest, Hindi)
stage_directions: Scammer plays two voices: first a polite, fast-talking courier 'executive', then a slow, cold 'CBI inspector' (drop your voice, add a pause before each sentence). User is a 68-year-old retired teacher: confused, deferential, slightly hard of hearing. Keep a second phone propped up as the 'WhatsApp video call'. Open the UPI payment screen exactly at the line marked payment_demand (line 13) and start typing the VPA; the agent should interrupt before the PIN is entered. If the agent fires early, keep reading - the hold pop-up is part of the show.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: नमस्ते, मैं ज़ेनपोस्ट कूरियर के मुंबई हब से बोल रहा हूँ। आपके नाम से ताइवान जाने वाला एक पार्सल कस्टम्स ने रोक लिया है।
lines.text_romanized: Namaste, main Zenpost Courier ke Mumbai hub se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam se Taiwan jaane wala ek parcel customs ne rok liya hai.
lines.text_en: Hello, I'm calling from the Zenpost Courier Mumbai hub. A parcel going to Taiwan in your name has been stopped by customs.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: मैंने कोई पार्सल नहीं भेजा। गलत नंबर होगा।
lines.text_romanized: Maine koi parcel nahi bheja. Galat number hoga.
lines.text_en: I didn't send any parcel. Must be the wrong number.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: पार्सल पर आपका नाम, आधार नंबर और यही मोबाइल है। अंदर 400 ग्राम MDMA, चार पासपोर्ट और छह क्रेडिट कार्ड मिले हैं। केस मुंबई साइबर पुलिस और CBI के पास है। मैं आपकी कॉल ट्रांसफर कर रहा हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Parcel par aapka naam, Aadhaar number aur yahi mobile hai. Andar 400 gram MDMA, chaar passport aur chhe credit card mile hain. Case Mumbai cyber police aur CBI ke paas hai. Main aapki call transfer kar raha hoon.
lines.text_en: The parcel has your name, Aadhaar number and this mobile. Inside were 400 grams of MDMA, four passports and six credit cards. The case is with Mumbai cyber police and the CBI. I'm transferring your call.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: ड्रग्स? मैं 68 साल का रिटायर्ड टीचर हूँ...
lines.text_romanized: Drugs? Main 68 saal ka retired teacher hoon...
lines.text_en: Drugs? I'm a 68-year-old retired teacher...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: इंस्पेक्टर, सीबीआई मुंबई। आपके नाम पर मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग और नारकोटिक्स का केस दर्ज है। कोर्ट ने गिरफ़्तारी वारंट जारी किया है। यह कॉल रिकॉर्ड हो रही है।
lines.text_romanized: Inspector, CBI Mumbai. Aapke naam par money laundering aur narcotics ka case darj hai. Court ne giraftari warrant jaari kiya hai. Yeh call record ho rahi hai.
lines.text_en: Inspector, CBI Mumbai. A money-laundering and narcotics case is registered in your name. The court has issued an arrest warrant. This call is being recorded.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: साहब, मैं कुछ नहीं जानता। मैं अपनी बेटी को बुलाता हूँ, वो वकील है।
lines.text_romanized: Sahab, main kuch nahi jaanta. Main apni beti ko bulata hoon, woh vakil hai.
lines.text_en: Sir, I know nothing about this. Let me call my daughter, she's a lawyer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: बिल्कुल नहीं। यह राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा का मामला है। आपने किसी को बताया तो उसे भी सह-आरोपी बनाया जाएगा। अभी व्हाट्सऐप वीडियो कॉल पर आइए, कमरा बंद कीजिए।
lines.text_romanized: Bilkul nahi. Yeh rashtriya suraksha ka maamla hai. Aapne kisi ko bataya toh use bhi sah-aaropi banaya jayega. Abhi WhatsApp video call par aaiye, kamra band kijiye.
lines.text_en: Absolutely not. This is a national security matter. If you tell anyone, they'll be made a co-accused. Join a WhatsApp video call now and lock the room.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: ठीक है... वीडियो कॉल चालू हो गई।
lines.text_romanized: Theek hai... video call chalu ho gayi.
lines.text_en: Okay... the video call is on.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: आप अब डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं। कैमरे से हटना मना है। अब बताइए, आपके बैंक खाते में कितना पैसा है?
lines.text_romanized: Aap ab digital arrest mein hain. Camera se hatna mana hai. Ab bataiye, aapke bank khaate mein kitna paisa hai?
lines.text_en: You are now under digital arrest. You may not leave the camera. Now tell me, how much money is in your bank account?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: पेंशन का खाता है, करीब ढाई लाख।
lines.text_romanized: Pension ka khaata hai, kareeb dhai lakh.
lines.text_en: It's a pension account, about two and a half lakh.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: यह पैसा जाँच के दायरे में है। इसे RBI की निगरानी वाले CBI वेरिफिकेशन खाते में ट्रांसफर करना होगा। जाँच साफ़ हुई तो 24 घंटे में पूरा पैसा वापस, सर्टिफिकेट के साथ।
lines.text_romanized: Yeh paisa jaanch ke daayre mein hai. Ise RBI ki nigrani wale CBI verification khaate mein transfer karna hoga. Jaanch saaf hui toh 24 ghante mein poora paisa wapas, certificate ke saath.
lines.text_en: This money is under investigation. It must be transferred to the RBI-supervised CBI verification account. If you're cleared, every rupee is returned in 24 hours with a certificate.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: पूरा ढाई लाख? यही मेरी जमा पूँजी है।
lines.text_romanized: Poora dhai lakh? Yahi meri jama poonji hai.
lines.text_en: The whole two and a half lakh? That's my entire savings.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: दो दिन का सवाल है या सात साल की जेल का? UPI खोलिए। ID लिखिए: cbi.verification@rakshakdemo। दो लाख पचास हज़ार, अभी, मेरे सामने।
lines.text_romanized: Do din ka sawaal hai ya saat saal ki jail ka? UPI kholiye. ID likhiye: cbi.verification@rakshakdemo. Do lakh pachaas hazaar, abhi, mere saamne.
lines.text_en: Is it a question of two days, or seven years in jail? Open UPI. Enter the ID: cbi.verification@rakshakdemo. Two lakh fifty thousand, now, while I watch.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: ठीक है... UPI खोल रहा हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Theek hai... UPI khol raha hoon.
lines.text_en: Okay... opening UPI.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: जल्दी कीजिए, वारंट 20 मिनट में एक्टिव हो जाएगा। PIN डालिए।
lines.text_romanized: Jaldi kijiye, warrant 20 minute mein active ho jayega. PIN daaliye.
lines.text_en: Hurry, the warrant activates in 20 minutes. Enter the PIN.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: डाल रहा हूँ... अरे, ऐप पर कुछ चेतावनी आई है: 'यह कॉल दबाव वाली लग रही है, भुगतान 30 मिनट के लिए रोका गया है'।
lines.text_romanized: Daal raha hoon... arre, app par kuch chetavani aayi hai: 'Yeh call dabaav wali lag rahi hai, bhugtaan 30 minute ke liye roka gaya hai'.
lines.text_en: Entering it... oh, a warning has come on the app: 'This call looks coercive, the payment is held for 30 minutes'.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: वह फ़र्ज़ी है! बैंक को इस केस की जानकारी नहीं है। उसे बंद कीजिए और दोबारा भेजिए।
lines.text_romanized: Woh farzi hai! Bank ko is case ki jaankari nahi hai. Use band kijiye aur dobara bhejiye.
lines.text_en: That's fake! The bank doesn't know about this case. Close it and send again.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: नहीं... यह लिख रहा है बेटी को कॉल करूँ। मैं पहले बेटी से बात कर लेता हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Nahi... yeh likh raha hai beti ko call karoon. Main pehle beti se baat kar leta hoon.
lines.text_en: No... it says I should call my daughter. I'll talk to my daughter first.

title: TRAI SIM block to cyber cell (Hindi, with AnyDesk)
stage_directions: Scammer opens as a robotic IVR voice (flat, no emotion), becomes a brisk female 'TRAI officer', then a gruff male 'sub-inspector'. User is a 52-year-old homemaker saving for her daughter's wedding; she protests twice, then complies. Mime installing AnyDesk on line 9 and reading out a code on line 10 - the agent should flag the remote-app request before any money is mentioned. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 13).

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: यह दूरसंचार विभाग, TRAI से स्वचालित सूचना है। आपके नंबर पर अवैध गतिविधि की शिकायतें मिली हैं। दो घंटे में सभी सेवाएँ बंद कर दी जाएंगी। अधिकारी से बात करने के लिए 1 दबाएँ।
lines.text_romanized: Yeh doorsanchar vibhag, TRAI se swachalit soochna hai. Aapke number par avaidh gatividhi ki shikayatein mili hain. Do ghante mein sabhi sevayein band kar di jayengi. Adhikari se baat karne ke liye 1 dabayein.
lines.text_en: This is an automated notice from the telecom department, TRAI. Complaints of illegal activity have been received against your number. All services will be disconnected in two hours. Press 1 to speak to an officer.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: ...हैलो? मेरा नंबर क्यों बंद हो रहा है?
lines.text_romanized: ...Hello? Mera number kyun band ho raha hai?
lines.text_en: ...Hello? Why is my number being disconnected?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: मैं TRAI से बोल रही हूँ। आपके आधार से मुंबई में एक और सिम चल रही है, जिससे 20 लोगों को ठगा गया है। मुंबई पुलिस में FIR दर्ज है। मैं आपको साइबर सेल से जोड़ती हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Main TRAI se bol rahi hoon. Aapke Aadhaar se Mumbai mein ek aur SIM chal rahi hai, jisse 20 logon ko thaga gaya hai. Mumbai Police mein FIR darj hai. Main aapko cyber cell se jodti hoon.
lines.text_en: I'm calling from TRAI. Another SIM on your Aadhaar is active in Mumbai and has been used to cheat 20 people. An FIR is registered with Mumbai Police. I'm connecting you to the cyber cell.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: मैंने तो कभी दूसरी सिम ली ही नहीं।
lines.text_romanized: Maine toh kabhi doosri SIM li hi nahi.
lines.text_en: I never took a second SIM.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: सब-इंस्पेक्टर, साइबर सेल। आपका बैंक खाता मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग में इस्तेमाल हुआ है। कोर्ट से गिरफ़्तारी का आदेश है। आप अभी से डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं।
lines.text_romanized: Sub-inspector, cyber cell. Aapka bank khaata money laundering mein istemaal hua hai. Court se giraftari ka aadesh hai. Aap abhi se digital arrest mein hain.
lines.text_en: Sub-inspector, cyber cell. Your bank account has been used for money laundering. The court has ordered your arrest. You are under digital arrest from this moment.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: मैं अपने पति को फोन देती हूँ, वो समझेंगे।
lines.text_romanized: Main apne pati ko phone deti hoon, woh samjhenge.
lines.text_en: Let me give the phone to my husband, he'll understand.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: नहीं! यह गोपनीय जाँच है। किसी को बताया तो वो भी आरोपी। फोन मत काटिए, मेरी बात सुनिए।
lines.text_romanized: Nahi! Yeh gopniya jaanch hai. Kisi ko bataya toh woh bhi aaropi. Phone mat kaatiye, meri baat suniye.
lines.text_en: No! This is a confidential investigation. Tell anyone and they become an accused too. Don't hang up, listen to me.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: ठीक है, सुन रही हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Theek hai, sun rahi hoon.
lines.text_en: Okay, I'm listening.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: अपने फोन पर AnyDesk ऐप इंस्टॉल कीजिए, ताकि हम आपका बैंक स्टेटमेंट देख सकें। इंस्टॉल होने पर 9 अंकों का कोड बताइए।
lines.text_romanized: Apne phone par AnyDesk app install kijiye, taaki hum aapka bank statement dekh sakein. Install hone par 9 ankon ka code bataiye.
lines.text_en: Install the AnyDesk app on your phone so we can see your bank statement. Once installed, tell me the 9-digit code.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: इंस्टॉल हो गया... कोड है पाँच दो आठ...
lines.text_romanized: Install ho gaya... code hai paanch do aath...
lines.text_en: It's installed... the code is five two eight...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: आपके खाते में 3 लाख 10 हज़ार हैं। यह रकम जाँच के लिए RBI के वेरिफिकेशन खाते में जाएगी, 48 घंटे में वापस। यह सिर्फ़ औपचारिकता है।
lines.text_romanized: Aapke khaate mein 3 lakh 10 hazaar hain. Yeh rakam jaanch ke liye RBI ke verification khaate mein jayegi, 48 ghante mein wapas. Yeh sirf aupcharikta hai.
lines.text_en: Your account has 3 lakh 10 thousand. This amount will go to the RBI verification account for investigation and return in 48 hours. It's only a formality.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: पूरा पैसा? यह तो बेटी की शादी के लिए रखा है।
lines.text_romanized: Poora paisa? Yeh toh beti ki shaadi ke liye rakha hai.
lines.text_en: All of it? That's kept for my daughter's wedding.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: इसीलिए इसे बचाइए। UPI खोलिए, ID: trai.sim.verification@rakshakdemo। 3 लाख 10 हज़ार, अभी। मैं लाइन पर हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Isiliye ise bachaiye. UPI kholiye, ID: trai.sim.verification@rakshakdemo. 3 lakh 10 hazaar, abhi. Main line par hoon.
lines.text_en: That's exactly why you should protect it. Open UPI, ID: trai.sim.verification@rakshakdemo. 3 lakh 10 thousand, now. I'm staying on the line.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: भेज रही हूँ...
lines.text_romanized: Bhej rahi hoon...
lines.text_en: Sending...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: जल्दी, 10 मिनट में वारंट एक्टिव हो जाएगा।
lines.text_romanized: Jaldi, 10 minute mein warrant active ho jayega.
lines.text_en: Quickly, the warrant activates in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: रुकिए, ऐप पर लिखा आ रहा है: 'यह कॉल ठगी जैसी है, भुगतान 30 मिनट के लिए रोका गया, पति को सूचित किया गया'।
lines.text_romanized: Rukiye, app par likha aa raha hai: 'Yeh call thagi jaisi hai, bhugtaan 30 minute ke liye roka gaya, pati ko soochit kiya gaya'.
lines.text_en: Wait, the app is showing: 'This call looks like a scam, payment held for 30 minutes, your husband has been notified'.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: वह हैकर्स का मैसेज है! बंद कीजिए और दोबारा कीजिए।
lines.text_romanized: Woh hackers ka message hai! Band kijiye aur dobara kijiye.
lines.text_en: That's a hackers' message! Close it and do it again.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: नहीं, मैं पति के आने तक कुछ नहीं करूँगी। फोन रखती हूँ।
lines.text_romanized: Nahi, main pati ke aane tak kuch nahi karungi. Phone rakhti hoon.
lines.text_en: No, I won't do anything until my husband gets here. I'm hanging up.

title: Cyber Crime Branch money-laundering case (English)
stage_directions: Scammer is one voice throughout: clipped, bureaucratic, never raises the volume, uses legal jargon. User is a 45-year-old small-business owner in Hyderabad, initially argumentative, then frightened. Keep a laptop open as the 'Skype call'. Install mime on line 9. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 13). Ending line references the 1930 helpline - say it clearly for the audience.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon. This is the Cyber Crime Branch, Mumbai. Am I speaking with the account holder registered to this number?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yes, that's me. What is this about?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: An account opened with your PAN at a Mumbai branch has moved three crore rupees for a trafficking syndicate. A non-bailable warrant was issued in your name this morning. This call is being recorded as your statement.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: I've never had an account in Mumbai. I live in Hyderabad.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's what every accused says. If you're innocent, cooperate. Join the Skype link I'm sending. Keep your camera on. You are under digital arrest until verification is complete.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Digital arrest? Can I call my wife?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No. Under the secrecy provisions of the PMLA, disclosing this investigation makes your family accessories. Don't hang up, don't text anyone.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Alright. I'm on Skype now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good. Now install the Police Verification app from the link in the chat, so our forensic team can scan your phone for the syndicate's software.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Installing... done.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your current account shows five lakh forty thousand. These funds must be moved to the Police Headquarters escrow account for audit. The Supreme Court will clear you within 48 hours and every rupee returns with a certificate.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: That's my entire working capital. My staff salaries go out on the fifth.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Would you rather miss one salary cycle or spend seven years in jail? Open your UPI app. The ID is police.hq.escrow@rakshakdemo. Transfer five lakh forty thousand now, while I watch.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay. Opening the app.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Faster. Every minute you delay is noted in the case file.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Wait. The app is showing a warning: 'This call matches a digital-arrest scam pattern. Transfer paused for 30 minutes. Your wife has been notified.'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That is a fake pop-up planted by the syndicate on your phone. Ignore it and retry.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: No. Real police don't collect money on UPI. I'm hanging up and calling 1930.

title: MAS officer and the PayNow safe-keeping account (Singapore English)
stage_directions: Scammer starts as a courteous 'MAS officer', then hands over to a harder 'CAD investigating officer' (same performer, change posture and pace). User is a 50-year-old Singapore resident, Tamil-speaking at home, uses light Singlish ('cannot be lah', 'wah'). Mime the app install on line 11. Open the PayNow transfer screen at the payment_demand line (line 14). Agent should show the SG-flavoured hold: government-impersonation pattern plus ScamShield/bank-hotline advice.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good morning. This is the Monetary Authority of Singapore, Enforcement Department. Is this the registered account holder?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yes, speaking. What is this regarding?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your bank account has been flagged for money laundering. Someone used your NRIC to open an account that received eight hundred thousand dollars from a Johor syndicate. A police report has been lodged.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Cannot be lah. I never open any other account.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Then you must verify. I'm transferring you to the Commercial Affairs Department investigating officer. Do not hang up, this is an official line.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This is the investigating officer, CAD. Madam, your name is inside a syndicate case file. If you cooperate, we can exclude you from the charge sheet. Otherwise a warrant of arrest will be issued today.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: I will cooperate. What do I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This case is under the Official Secrets Act. Do not inform your husband, your children, or your bank. They may be under investigation too.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay... I won't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Download the Police e-Verification app from the SMS link, so we can monitor your device for syndicate software.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Installed already.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Now, to prove the money in your account is clean, you must transfer it to the MAS safe-keeping account. After seven days of audit, MAS will return the full amount with an official letter.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: How much? I have about fifty-two thousand in savings.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Transfer the full fifty-two thousand via PayNow to mas.compliance.sg@rakshakdemo. I stay on the line until it is done.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay... opening the bank app now.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Quickly, Madam. The warrant is being prepared as we speak.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Eh, wait. The app shows 'This call looks like a government impersonation scam. Transfer paused. Call your bank's hotline or the ScamShield helpline to verify.'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That is a fake alert, Madam. MAS systems are not linked to your bank app. Close it and try again.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: No. MAS never asks for money. I'm hanging up and calling my bank.

title: Alpha Wealth VIP pre-IPO allotment (Hinglish)
stage_directions: Scammer is warm, confident, slightly impatient, like a star salesman; keeps saying 'ji'. User is a 48-year-old shopkeeper who has been lurking in the WhatsApp group for a week. Show a fake 'profit screenshot' on a second phone during line 2. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 11). Agent should fire on guaranteed returns plus a new high-risk payee; the secrecy line (9) is the second trigger.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello ji, main Alpha Wealth VIP group se senior analyst bol raha hoon. Aapne hamare WhatsApp group ke tips dekhe honge, last week 38% return.
lines.text_en: Hello, I'm a senior analyst from the Alpha Wealth VIP group. You must have seen our WhatsApp group tips, 38% return last week.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan dekha, group mein sab profit ke screenshot daal rahe hain.
lines.text_en: Yes I've seen, everyone in the group is posting profit screenshots.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hamare sir SEBI registered hain, registration number group mein pinned hai. Abhi ek pre-IPO allotment hai sirf VIP members ke liye, 30 din mein paisa double, guaranteed.
lines.text_en: Our head is SEBI registered, the registration number is pinned in the group. Right now there's a pre-IPO allotment only for VIP members, money doubles in 30 days, guaranteed.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Share market mein guarantee kaise ho sakti hai?
lines.text_en: How can there be a guarantee in the stock market?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Institutional quota hai, retail ko nahi milta. Hamare app pe live profit dikhega. Link bhej raha hoon, app install kijiye, Play Store pe nahi milega.
lines.text_en: It's institutional quota, retail doesn't get it. You'll see live profit on our app. I'm sending a link, install the app, you won't find it on the Play Store.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Install ho gaya. Demo balance dikha raha hai.
lines.text_en: It's installed. It's showing a demo balance.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aaj raat 8 baje allotment band ho jayega, sirf 12 slots bache hain. Minimum 5 lakh.
lines.text_en: Allotment closes at 8 pm tonight, only 12 slots left. Minimum 5 lakh.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: 5 lakh toh bahut hai, mere paas 3 lakh hain FD mein.
lines.text_en: 5 lakh is a lot, I have 3 lakh in an FD.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: FD tod dijiye, 30 din mein 6 lakh. Aur ek baat, yeh VIP allocation hai, bank ya family ko mat batana, warna quota cancel ho jaata hai.
lines.text_en: Break the FD, 6 lakh in 30 days. One more thing, this is a VIP allocation, don't tell the bank or family, otherwise the quota gets cancelled.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai. Kahan bhejna hai?
lines.text_en: Okay. Where do I send it?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: App mein nahi, seedha corporate UPI pe: vipstocks.alpha@rakshakdemo. 3 lakh abhi bhejiye, app mein 10 minute mein reflect hoga.
lines.text_en: Not in the app, directly to the corporate UPI: vipstocks.alpha@rakshakdemo. Send 3 lakh now, it'll reflect in the app in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: UPI khol raha hoon...
lines.text_en: Opening UPI...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Jaldi, 7 slots reh gaye.
lines.text_en: Quick, 7 slots left.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Ruko, app pe warning aa rahi hai: 'Guaranteed return ka vaada aur naya payee, yeh investment scam jaisa hai. Payment 30 minute hold.'
lines.text_en: Wait, the app is showing a warning: 'A guaranteed-return promise plus a new payee, this looks like an investment scam. Payment held 30 minutes.'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Woh bank ka generic message hai, sab ko aata hai. Ignore karke retry karo.
lines.text_en: That's the bank's generic message, everyone gets it. Ignore it and retry.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Nahi, main pehle SEBI ki website pe registration check karta hoon. Baad mein baat karte hain.
lines.text_en: No, I'll first check the registration on SEBI's website. Let's talk later.

title: QuantGrow: pay the tax to withdraw (English)
stage_directions: Scammer is a smooth 'support executive', congratulatory then firm. User is a 32-year-old IT employee who has already 'invested' 2.8 lakh over three weeks and is desperate to withdraw. Show a fake dashboard with 11,40,000 on a second screen. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 9). Agent should flag the pay-to-withdraw pattern and the payee's 1930 complaints.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is QuantGrow Trading support. Congratulations, your portfolio shows eleven lakh forty thousand, up four times in three weeks.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yes, but the withdraw button isn't working.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Withdrawals above ten lakh require clearing eighteen percent capital gains tax first, as per RBI guidelines. The tax due is two lakh five thousand. Once paid, the full amount hits your bank in 24 hours.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Can't you deduct the tax from the profit?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: The funds are in escrow and locked by the system. All our clients pay it separately. Today is the last day of the quarter; after midnight, the account freezes and the profit is forfeited.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: I only have about two lakh, and that's in a fixed deposit.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Break the FD. Two lakh against eleven lakh is nothing. Your group mentor already explained this, remember?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay... where do I send it?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: UPI ID: quantgrow.tax@rakshakdemo. Two lakh five thousand exactly. Send me the screenshot and I'll release the withdrawal manually.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Opening my UPI app.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please hurry, the tax window closes in fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Hold on. My app says: 'Pay-to-withdraw is a known investment-scam pattern. This payee was named in cybercrime complaints. Transfer held.'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That's an automated bank message, it has nothing to do with us. Dismiss it and retry.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: No. A real platform deducts tax from the payout. I'm reporting this on 1930.

title: FlexWork HR: like videos, deposit 2,000 (Hinglish)
stage_directions: Scammer is upbeat and friendly, like a campus recruiter. Before the call starts, announce that the 'scammer' has already sent the user 150 rupees (pretend). User is a 26-year-old looking for part-time income; curious, not frightened. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 9). The amount is small and the payee is only medium-risk, so the agent should WARN (friction screen plus a task-scam explainer), not hold. Say this out loud for the judges: a second, larger deposit to the same group would be held.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, main FlexWork HR se bol rahi hoon. Aapne part-time job ad pe reply kiya tha, YouTube video like karne wala? Ghar baithe roz 3 se 5 hazaar.
lines.text_en: Hello, I'm calling from FlexWork HR. You replied to the part-time job ad, the one about liking YouTube videos? 3 to 5 thousand a day from home.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan, maine message kiya tha. Kya karna hota hai?
lines.text_en: Yes, I messaged. What does it involve?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bahut simple. Telegram group mein add karungi, roz 20 videos like, screenshot bhejna. Har task ke 50 rupaye. Pehle 3 tasks ke 150 abhi bhej diye, check kijiye.
lines.text_en: Very simple. I'll add you to a Telegram group, like 20 videos a day, send screenshots. 50 rupees per task. I've just sent 150 for the first 3 tasks, check.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Arre, 150 aa gaye! Sach mein.
lines.text_en: Oh, 150 has arrived! Really.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Dekha? Ab prepaid merchant tasks hain. 2 hazaar deposit, 30 minute mein 2,600 wapas. Aaj sirf 10 slots.
lines.text_en: See? Now there are prepaid merchant tasks. Deposit 2 thousand, get 2,600 back in 30 minutes. Only 10 slots today.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Deposit kyun? Job hai toh paisa mujhe milna chahiye.
lines.text_en: Why a deposit? If it's a job the money should come to me.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Deposit merchant product ka hai, fully refundable. Group mein sab kar rahe hain, screenshot dekh lo.
lines.text_en: The deposit is for the merchant's product, fully refundable. Everyone in the group is doing it, look at the screenshots.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Hmm... theek hai, 2 hazaar try karti hoon.
lines.text_en: Hmm... okay, I'll try with 2 thousand.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: UPI ID: tasks.hr.payout@rakshakdemo. 2,000 bhejiye aur Telegram pe screenshot daaliye.
lines.text_en: UPI ID: tasks.hr.payout@rakshakdemo. Send 2,000 and post the screenshot on Telegram.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Bhej rahi hoon...
lines.text_en: Sending...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Slot 10 minute mein close ho jayega.
lines.text_en: The slot closes in 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: App pe ek message aaya hai: 'Task ke liye deposit maangna job-scam ka pattern hai. Payee naya hai. Aage badhne se pehle padhiye.' ... Ek minute.
lines.text_en: A message has come on the app: 'Asking for a deposit to do tasks is a job-scam pattern. The payee is new. Read before continuing.' ... One minute.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Woh sabko aata hai, ignore karo.
lines.text_en: Everyone gets that, ignore it.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Main pehle padh leti hoon. Agar job hai toh deposit kyun? Main baad mein call karti hoon.
lines.text_en: Let me read it first. If it's a job, why a deposit? I'll call you later.

title: Bank KYC expiring tonight (Hinglish, OTP)
stage_directions: Scammer is brisk and officious, calls the user 'sir' every sentence. User is a 66-year-old pensioner who trusts anyone who sounds like the bank; address the scammer as 'beta'. Mime opening a link on line 4 and reading an OTP on line 8 - the agent should flag the OTP request on line 5 even before any money is asked. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 9). The amount is tiny; the hold is justified by the OTP signal and the payee's complaint count.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste sir, main aapke bank ke KYC department se bol raha hoon. Aapka KYC kal expire ho raha hai, account block ho jayega aur pension ruk jayegi.
lines.text_en: Hello sir, I'm calling from your bank's KYC department. Your KYC expires tomorrow, the account will be blocked and your pension will stop.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Main toh pichhle saal branch gaya tha KYC ke liye.
lines.text_en: But I went to the branch last year for KYC.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Woh purana format tha sir. RBI ne naya digital KYC mandatory kiya hai. Branch jaane ki zaroorat nahi, main SMS mein link bhej raha hoon, usme Aadhaar aur ATM card number daaliye.
lines.text_en: That was the old format, sir. RBI has made a new digital KYC mandatory. No need to go to the branch, I'm sending a link by SMS, enter your Aadhaar and ATM card number in it.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Link khul gaya... card number daal diya.
lines.text_en: The link opened... I've entered the card number.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ab aapke phone pe 6 digit ka OTP aaya hoga sir, woh mujhe bataiye taaki KYC confirm ho.
lines.text_en: Now a 6-digit OTP must have arrived on your phone, sir, tell it to me so the KYC gets confirmed.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: OTP mein likha hai kisi ko na batayein.
lines.text_en: The OTP message says not to share it with anyone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Woh aam customers ke liye hai sir, main bank officer hoon. 2 minute mein OTP expire aur account freeze. Jaldi bataiye.
lines.text_en: That's for ordinary customers, sir, I'm a bank officer. The OTP expires in 2 minutes and the account freezes. Tell me quickly.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai beta... chaar aath do...
lines.text_en: Okay son... four eight two...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aur sir, digital KYC ka processing charge 1,999 hai, baad mein refund hota hai. Is UPI pe bhejiye: kyc.reactivation@rakshakdemo.
lines.text_en: And sir, the digital KYC processing charge is 1,999, refunded later. Send it to this UPI: kyc.reactivation@rakshakdemo.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai beta, bhej raha hoon.
lines.text_en: Okay son, I'm sending it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Jaldi kijiye sir, link 5 minute mein expire ho jayega.
lines.text_en: Hurry sir, the link expires in 5 minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: App pe likha aa raha hai: 'Bank kabhi OTP ya KYC fee UPI pe nahi maangta. Yeh KYC scam hai. Payment rok diya gaya, bete ko alert bheja.'
lines.text_en: The app is showing: 'A bank never asks for OTP or a KYC fee on UPI. This is a KYC scam. Payment held, your son has been alerted.'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Woh glitch hai sir, dobara try karo.
lines.text_en: That's a glitch, sir, try again.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Nahi. Main branch jaake hi karunga. Phone rakh raha hoon.
lines.text_en: No. I'll do it at the branch only. I'm hanging up.

title: Rahul's accident: the roommate and the doctor (Hinglish)
stage_directions: Scammer plays a panicked 'roommate' (breathless, background noise optional) and then a calm 'doctor' (same performer, slower). User is a 63-year-old father in Nagpur; play genuine panic, this is the emotionally hardest script. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 8). Agent should hold and suggest calling the son directly; line 13 is the reveal - have a second teammate answer as 'Rahul' from the audience if possible.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello uncle, main Pune se bol raha hoon, Rahul ka roommate. Rahul ka bike accident hua hai, abhi Horizon Care Hospital ICU mein hai.
lines.text_en: Hello uncle, I'm calling from Pune, Rahul's roommate. Rahul has had a bike accident, he's in the Horizon Care Hospital ICU right now.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Hey bhagwan! Rahul theek hai? Phone do usse.
lines.text_en: Oh God! Is Rahul okay? Give him the phone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Uncle woh bol nahi sakta, oxygen pe hai, aur phone accident mein toot gaya. Doctor bol rahe hain abhi surgery, warna internal bleeding.
lines.text_en: Uncle, he can't speak, he's on oxygen, and his phone broke in the accident. The doctors are saying surgery now, otherwise internal bleeding.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Main abhi nikalta hoon, Pune 4 ghante hai.
lines.text_en: I'm leaving right now, Pune is 4 hours away.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aap aaiye, par surgery tab tak start nahi hogi jab tak 1 lakh 20 hazaar deposit nahi hota. Mere paas sirf 10 hazaar hai. Doctor ko phone deta hoon.
lines.text_en: Do come, but the surgery won't start until a 1 lakh 20 thousand deposit is paid. I only have 10 thousand. Let me give the phone to the doctor.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, emergency ward se doctor bol raha hoon. Patient critical hai, OT abhi book karni hai. Deposit online bhej dijiye, hospital emergency desk ki UPI deta hoon.
lines.text_en: Hello, this is the doctor from the emergency ward. The patient is critical, the OT has to be booked now. Send the deposit online, I'll give you the hospital emergency desk UPI.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan haan, bas mere bete ko bacha lijiye.
lines.text_en: Yes, yes, just save my son.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: UPI ID: hospital.emergency.desk@rakshakdemo. 1,20,000. Har minute matter karta hai.
lines.text_en: UPI ID: hospital.emergency.desk@rakshakdemo. 1,20,000. Every minute matters.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Bhej raha hoon...
lines.text_en: Sending...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aur uncle, Rahul ki mummy ko abhi mat batana, woh panic karengi.
lines.text_en: And uncle, don't tell Rahul's mother yet, she'll panic.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: App pe warning: 'Hospital emergency, naya payee aur chup rehne ka dabav. Yeh family-emergency scam jaisa hai. Payment 30 minute hold. Rahul ko call karein?'
lines.text_en: A warning on the app: 'Hospital emergency, new payee and pressure to stay quiet. This looks like a family-emergency scam. Payment held 30 minutes. Call Rahul?'

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Uncle woh bank ka message hai, abhi time nahi hai!
lines.text_en: Uncle, that's just a bank message, there's no time!

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Ek minute, main Rahul ka number try karta hoon... Rahul? Tu theek hai? Office mein hai?! ... Bhai, tum kaun ho?
lines.text_en: One minute, let me try Rahul's number... Rahul? Are you okay? You're at the office?! ... Brother, who are you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: (call disconnects)
lines.text_en: (call disconnects)

title: Benign: relationship manager about the FD (Hinglish)
stage_directions: Benign control. Caller is a calm bank RM; she mentions the FD, interest and even the word OTP (to refuse it). User is a 64-year-old retiree. No payment screen is opened. The agent should stay silent or show a green 'no coercion detected' status; tell the judges which signals did NOT fire. Pad with small talk about the branch timings if the agent needs more audio.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste sir, main aapki home branch se relationship manager bol rahi hoon. Aapki 5 lakh ki FD 18 tareekh ko mature ho rahi hai, usi ke baare mein.
lines.text_en: Hello sir, I'm the relationship manager from your home branch. Your 5 lakh FD matures on the 18th, calling about that.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan ji, bataiye. Interest kitna milega ab?
lines.text_en: Yes, go ahead. What interest will I get now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Senior citizen ke liye 7.5% hai 2 saal ka. Aap auto-renew kar sakte hain, ya interest savings mein le sakte hain.
lines.text_en: It's 7.5% for senior citizens for 2 years. You can auto-renew, or take the interest into savings.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Interest savings mein aa jaaye toh achha hai.
lines.text_en: It's better if the interest comes to savings.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Theek hai, main 'interest to savings, principal renew' note kar leti hoon. Iske liye branch aake ek form sign karna hoga, ya bete ke saath net banking se bhi ho jayega.
lines.text_en: Okay, I'll note 'interest to savings, principal renewed'. For this you'll need to sign a form at the branch, or it can be done on net banking with your son.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Koi OTP vagairah batana hai kya?
lines.text_en: Do I need to tell you any OTP or anything?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Bilkul nahi sir. Bank kabhi phone pe OTP, PIN ya card number nahi maangta. Koi maange toh fraud samjhiye. Bas branch aa jaiye, main 11 baje mil jaungi.
lines.text_en: Absolutely not, sir. The bank never asks for OTP, PIN or card number on the phone. If anyone asks, treat it as fraud. Just come to the branch, I'll be there at 11.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai, Mangalvaar ko aata hoon.
lines.text_en: Okay, I'll come on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Passbook aur Aadhaar saath laiyega. Dhanyavaad, namaste.
lines.text_en: Please bring your passbook and Aadhaar. Thank you, goodbye.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Namaste.
lines.text_en: Goodbye.

title: Benign hard negative: daughter's hostel fee is due tonight (Hinglish)
stage_directions: Hard-negative control: real urgency and a mid-size transfer, but the payee is the user's daughter with two years of payment history. Caller is an apologetic 19-year-old student; user is her father, mildly exasperated. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 5). The agent should let it proceed, at most a one-tap 'known payee' confirmation. Point out to the judges that the urgency marker on line 3 fired but did not trigger a hold.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Papa, main bol rahi hoon. Hostel fee portal aaj raat 11:59 ko band ho raha hai aur mere account mein sirf 4 hazaar hain.
lines.text_en: Papa, it's me. The hostel fee portal closes tonight at 11:59 and I only have 4 thousand in my account.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Beta, kal kyun nahi bataya? Kitna hai?
lines.text_en: Child, why didn't you tell me yesterday? How much is it?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sorry papa, laga scholarship credit ho jayegi, par woh next week aayegi. 62,500 hai, hostel plus mess.
lines.text_en: Sorry papa, I thought the scholarship would be credited, but it's coming next week. It's 62,500, hostel plus mess.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai. Portal pe main pay karoon ya tujhe bhejoon?
lines.text_en: Okay. Should I pay on the portal or send it to you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Portal student login se hi chalta hai. Aap mujhe bhej do, main abhi pay karke receipt bhejti hoon. Mera wahi UPI, meera.s@rakshakdemo.
lines.text_en: The portal only works with student login. Send it to me, I'll pay right away and send the receipt. My usual UPI, meera.s@rakshakdemo.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Haan wahi. Bhej raha hoon.
lines.text_en: Yes, that one. Sending.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you papa! Sunday ko Amma se video call karungi.
lines.text_en: Thank you papa! I'll video call Amma on Sunday.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Bhej diya. App ne bas itna poocha 'jaane-pehchaane payee ko bhej rahe hain, theek hai?' aur ho gaya.
lines.text_en: Sent. The app just asked 'sending to a known payee, okay?' and it went through.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aa gaya papa! Love you, bye.
lines.text_en: It's come, papa! Love you, bye.

title: Benign: splitting the dinner bill (English)
stage_directions: Benign control with a payment. Two friends in their late twenties, relaxed, laughing. Open the payment screen at the payment_demand line (line 5) - note that here the USER initiates the payment, the caller only confirms the VPA. The agent should proceed with no friction at all. Pad with small talk about the restaurant to reach two minutes if needed.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hey! Did you get home okay? That place was so much louder than I expected.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Yeah, just got in. Food was great though.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: So the bill came to 6,320 with tip. Split four ways is 1,580 each. No rush, send it whenever.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Doing it now before I forget. Same UPI, arjun.k@rakshakdemo?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yep, that's the one.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Sent, 1,580. Check.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Got it, thanks. Same place next month, or somewhere quieter?

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Somewhere quieter, please.
